title: Supply-tax Focus Deck

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved objective, canonical boundary, exact 21-slice scope, verification, rollback, promotion gate, and stop conditions.

allowedWork: Exact-rational zero-to-positive per-unit-tax equilibrium and welfare truth.
One bounded semantic asset, sampled frame, eight-beat score, Article, vignette, native SVG and KaTeX renderer, route, and Focus Deck projection.
Existing-clock adjacent, reverse, replay, rapid-repeat, distant-seek, URL, native-find, reduced-motion, accessibility, responsive, and scoped visual evidence.
disallowedWork: Destructive changes to the existing demand-shift lesson or model, shared Focus Deck extraction, or generalized Graph2D, tax, welfare, and surplus grammars.
Positive-tax-to-higher-tax scenarios, nonlinear curves, elasticity or incidence controls, sliders, calculators, custom search, duplicate hidden prose, or a deck-local clock.
Changes to log-product, delta-epsilon, integration, gallery, flashcard, Graph3D, or code exemplars beyond bounded preservation tests; broad cross-browser promotion before review.
goal: Build one document-backed eight-beat Focus Deck that explains an exact per-unit tax, welfare redistribution, and deadweight loss through semantic-snap navigation over the existing continuous clock.
commitCadence: Commit every independently reversible verified slice with exact path staging and completed Theseus evidence; never stage unrelated dirty files.
stopConditions: Stop if exact market-clearing or welfare identities fail or graph geometry must become economic truth.
Stop if original supply cannot remain marginal-cost evidence, direct seek must replay history, rapid navigation creates half-states, or a second clock is required.
Stop if native find requires duplicate hidden prose or custom search interception.
Stop if work requires shared Focus Deck extraction, destructive demand-shift migration, unrelated dirty-file ownership, or any disallowed expansion.
Stop at slice s21 for explicit human visual review before promotion or generalization.
